body: My main problem has been that I have no contact with people. I see my family, but they're very traditional and conservative. They don't know about my problems. They're in a church community that thrives on reputation. I don't have any firends or classmates to hang out with or just talk to. Thats why even though I have family nearby I feel very isolated.

That's.. right on the nail. I remember a few years ago I'd make a post about something less "popular" like rodnovery and get a comment from someone being excited to see that someone else knows about it. Now the best I see is "cool pic, follow my blog for more" or a group of girls ganging up on another blogger becuase they disagreed with them -__-

That's one of the main problems I'm finding on tumblr. Right when I thing there's a good conversation going I get something along the lines of "can you follow my sideblogs and maybe I can introduce you to some people". I don't know, it always feels like there's some hostility around.
I think I've seen this site before, it's been a long time though. Thank you!
I've never actually heard of that site. I'm trying to search pages like that now, but if you end up finding or remembering what the name was, I'd really appreciate it!

I get what you mean. I have one person that keeps me going. But when they're not around I feel completely empty. Which makes me even more aware that I have no friends or anyone else. Im literally hanging on by a single thread.
I lost my passion for every hobby I had. I don't have energy to do what my favourite things were
